sources.title: A Novel Feature Extraction and Fault Detection Technique for the Intelligent Fault Identification of Water Pump Bearings
sources.licenseVerification: CC-BY-4.0 confirmed on PMC full text
sources.scopeReviewed: Laboratory 2 HP induction motor driving a water pump; 6202-2z bearing; two seeded defects (0.5 mm hole and 0.5 x 0.5 x 5 mm scratch); current and voltage sensing; 640 samples across no-load, medium-load and full-load conditions.
limitations: Not field validation; one laboratory rig and one bearing model.
Reported 100% classification is limited to the paper's 640-sample experiment and 70/30 split; raw data are not supplied in the article.
Does not establish universal vibration/current thresholds or a pump-specific repair procedure.
Does not support cavitation, air-lock, suction-blockage or low-flow root-cause rules.
sources.reuseConditions: Paraphrase only with attribution under CC BY 4.0; do not reproduce figures/tables or treat lab thresholds as universal.

reference_only_documents.title: MDX Maintenance Manual — Installation/Operating Manual 2021.8/01-US
reference_only_documents.equipmentScope: GIW/KSB MDX slurry pump family only; not a generic centrifugal-pump procedure.
claimsSupported: Examples of insufficient-flow causes for this MDX manual: blocked suction/discharge piping, higher-than-expected system head, incomplete venting/priming, excess entrained air, partial impeller clogging and insufficient available suction head.
limitations: The manual itself warns that additional documentation may not apply to every pump; verify exact pump serial/model and supplied documentation.
Its low-flow percentage recommendation is model/family-specific and must not be copied as a universal threshold.
The manual is used as a linked reference only; no redistribution permission was verified.

reference_only_documents.title: KSB Centrifugal Pump Lexicon — Operating point / operating behaviour
reference_only_documents.equipmentScope: General centrifugal-pump concepts; actual application and pump design remain controlling.
claimsSupported: The operating point is the intersection of pump H/Q and system Hsys/Q curves; changes to pump or system curves shift the operating point.
limitations: General engineering reference, not a substitute for the exact pump curve or OEM manual.
No numeric operating limit is generalized from this article.

reference_only_documents.title: ASHRAE Handbook 2024 — Chapter 44: Centrifugal Pumps
sectionsReviewed: Section 6: Pump and Hydronic System Curves
reference_only_documents.equipmentScope: Centrifugal pumps in hydronic systems; not every industrial process application.
claimsSupported: The system operating point is the intersection of pump and system curves; system resistance includes pipe, fitting, valve and fluid-property effects.
limitations: Hydronic application scope; adapt only the general curve concept after confirming industrial system applicability.
Copyrighted handbook; no redistribution or text reproduction rights assumed.
